name: Air Fryer Chicken Flautas with Pico de Gallo

components.name: Chicken Flautas

ingredients.name: RAW boneless chicken breast to produce approx 340 g cooked shredded chicken
Olive oil to cook initial chicken
Twelve small flour tortillas, purchased weight

steps: Important: Skinnytaste's published flautas recipe starts with already-cooked shredded chicken. Our 450 g RAW chicken breast is an estimated input to yield 340 g cooked; weigh after cooking.
Cook raw chicken separately in the air fryer at 190 C until 74 C in the centre; rest and shred finely.
Stir shredded cooked chicken with diced green chilies, lime, garlic, cumin and cheese. Divide filling across 12 small tortillas and roll tightly.
Arrange flautas seam-down in a single layer in an oiled air fryer basket, spraying lightly; cook around 8-9 minutes per batch at 200 C, turning once, until crisp.
Freeze cooked flautas in separated layers if desired and re-crisp from thawed; refrigerate pico and do not freeze it.

components.name: Pico de Gallo
steps: Mix tomato, onion, coriander and lime for a separate chilled pico. Divide two flautas per meal for six servings; add pico at eating time.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Explicit raw-to-cooked conversion added because source calls for 12 oz COOKED chicken; cooked yields estimated.
Planning: Air fryer two stages: first chicken, then rolled flautas; may be a long multi-batch session.
Freezer: for flautas: uncooked or cooked; pico de gallo fresh only
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
